configurable_props.name: dateInfo
configurable_props.content: Date fields should be a [valid date string](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date#date_time_string_format) or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Example values: `2022-01-15T18:30:00.000Z` or `1642271400000`.

configurable_props.name: AcceptedEventInviteeIds
configurable_props.label: Accepted Event Invitee IDs
configurable_props.description: One or more Contact or Lead IDs who accepted this event.

configurable_props.name: ActivityDate
configurable_props.label: Due Date / Time
configurable_props.description: The date/time (`ActivityDateTime`) of the event, or only the date (`ActivityDate`) if it is an all-day event.

configurable_props.name: Description
configurable_props.label: Description
configurable_props.description: A text description of the event. Limit: 32,000 characters.

configurable_props.name: EndDateTime
configurable_props.label: End Date / Time
configurable_props.description: The date/time when the event ends.

configurable_props.name: IsAllDayEvent
configurable_props.label: All-Day Event
